summary: Moved the author proofs aside and built all three outputs from nothing with make doc (PROVIDER=claude). Each settled in two passes with clean logs: no warnings, undefined references, overfull or underfull boxes, or font substitutions. Research PDF: 33 pages, cbdec17636a338b03f5dbbffaec2a0162724358d0a3b074bcb286aca988e8fb2. Concise PDF: 12 pages, 106d21c0ac77cb1dfdd303f2e6ba224702fb24fc81d03823611f00ddad3b1261. Homily PDF: 4 pages, 2e2391674df899ed5e86558609da28d1c63ffefa112cb765b1a495f105b24a7e. All three are byte-identical to the derive-homily builds. Their extracted text matches the reviewed proofs except for the revision-timestamp line. The concise zref abspage markers put the inventory, overview and four senses on page 1, the chronology on page 2, the themes on pages 3-4 and the commentary from page 5; the folio equals the physical page at every marker. Structure, font and extraction checks passed: pdfinfo, pdffonts, pdftotext and Ghostscript all ran clean, every font is embedded Type 1 Latin Modern, and there are no images, trailer IDs or leaked run, model or path strings. The snapshot wrote research/artifacts.json (3 PDFs, 28 render inputs, 2 aux files), and every digest was re-verified. The artifact gate command, check-proper-components (all editions) and check-generation-metadata exit 0. The four content seals (research, study, synthesis, homily) still equal their accepted review inputs. tools/tpt pdf-review wrote 49 rasters and 4 contact sheets to artifacts/build-artifacts-0000/rasters; the evidence copies and SHA256SUMS are in the sibling proof/. No source or layout edit was made, and the generation timestamp is unchanged. The only tracked writes are research/artifacts.json and the Build-artifacts entry in research/production-review.md, which lists presentation points for the visual reviewer. No semantic defect was met. No PDF was installed, and no visual acceptance is claimed.
